meta.title: SLATE research: more cleaning supplies at the grocers, a shelf's brands before its sizes
meta.method: Read 2026-10-04 from the Wynshop storefrontgateway search API the first supplies research used (research-household-supplies.json): Price Rite (store 301), The Fresh Grocer (197), Smart & Final (371) and SuperValu (5550). Save-On-Foods' answered a Cloudflare challenge and wasn't read. Up to 8 of each kind a chain, one of each brand first, each at its regular shelf price; a product on a temporary price reduction is left out, as the feed doesn't show its regular price. A brand is the feed's where the product's own name states it.
